events.title: We're back!
events.summary: Hey everyone, E33 Studios here. We wanted to take a moment to apologize for stepping away from the project without giving you the clarity you deserved. The break was necessary, but we should have communicated earlier and more openlyOur small team is back now, fully committed to finishing the game and delivering a fun experience for friends to enjoy. We appreciate everyone who stuck around, checked in, or simply waited quietly. Your patience means a lot, and our team doesn't take it for granted.M

events.title: Blam! Blam! Updates
events.summary: Hi Everyone!Wanted to share an update for you. As we released we got some feedback that apocalypse and multiplayer felt very disconnected. We went ahead and incorporated the multiplayer levels into Apocalypse with a helicopter ride between each map. In addition to the multiplayer levels we added a crit system. Our goal also was to make Apocalypse more fun by taking away some of the punishment of the cards. Overall we think it improves the fun factor of the game. Don't worry for those that enjoy

events.title: Blam! Blam! Demo Release!
events.summary: Hi Everyone!We were able to get the Blam! Blam! demo released! Come check it out!Our little group plans to hop on every Friday for the next few weeks to play with you all! Our goal is to put a way for you all to give us feedback as well as report bugs.We hope to see you all lighting up the battlefield this Friday!Come join us on our Discord. E33 Studios Discord We would love to hear what ideas may be fun to implement.

events.title: Blam! Blam! DEMO Scheduled for release!
events.summary: Hi Everyone, The demo passed the review! We are scheduled to release it next week. The current planned date is set for Monday October 6th at 9pm. We are ecstatic to get the demo to everyone! Thank you for Come join us on our Discord. E33 Studios Discord We would love to hear what ideas may be fun to implement.

events.title: Blam! Blam! DEMO Submitted!
events.summary: Hi Everyone, We have big news! We were able to get through the list of bugs we had. Our demo has been submitted for review. The Steam review team says it takes 5 days to work through the review process. Assuming nothing goes south we will have the demo release in the next week or so!Thank you all again for being patient with us. We are very excited to have it accessible to the public and to see what you all are wanting in the future from Blam! Blam!Come join us on our Discord. E33 Studios Discor

Long story short as our team has learned and evolved with the Godot platform some of our original code caused certain things to not close correctly in the background. events.title: Blam! Blam! Weekly Update 17 | MORE Testing / Improvements
events.summary: Hi Everyone! We had a very full and eventful last week. We were able to have 10 simultaneous players running around at the same time! As we did that we found that a few things were a bit on the difficult side when you had 10 friends in a call together. Bits of pieces of information weren't conveyed well enough when flipping from game mode to game mode. We are working on a way for information to be conveyed easily and well for all types of players. Come join us on our Discord. E33 Studios Discord

events.title: Blam! Blam! Weekly Update 9 & 10 | Playtesting / Tuning
events.summary: Hi Everyone! We are gearing up to prep for a demo release. Our little group is internally testing and trying to get it ready for an enjoyable experience. We think in the next 2 months we should have a demo out for everyone to pick and play. As we get closer we'd like to reach out to everyone and see if there are other game modes or adjustments that they'd like to see.
